description:
The objective of this project is to procure and install SCS conveyors in conjunction with SAC procurement for the end items being used (Steris Washers)  , including Standard SCS Double Load/Single Unload with Self Docking TC Adapter, Install SCS Conveyor 3 Modules, and 1st Year Preventive Care Connect AMSCO 7052HP, to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Sterile Processing Services (SPS) at the VA of Central Iowa Health Care System. 
The VA of Central Iowa Health Care System's Sterile Processing Services requires a reliable and efficient rack return system to ensure seamless operations and maintain high standards of sterilization.
